what_this_is: A provider description for tools/start-a-computer: the calls sent to this provider (`requests`), the credential named by vault handle (`vault_key`, never its value), and which request does each job. Name this file in a request's machine.provider (or name.provider for a name record).
name: A Linux machine you already run, over SSH
notes: Set placement.address to the machine's public IPv4 and placement.monthly_price_cents to what it costs you, if anything. Starting adopts that address; removing forgets it and never touches the machine.
